mapper.select: SELECT rc.id, COALESCE(rc.citation_label, rd.title) AS title, COALESCE(rc.content_text, rc.content) AS content, rc.source_position AS sourcePosition, MATCH(rc.content_text, rc.citation_label) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) AS lexicalScore FROM rag_chunk rc JOIN rag_document rd ON rd.id = rc.document_id WHERE rc.enabled = b'1' AND rd.status = 'ready' AND MATCH(rc.content_text, rc.citation_label) AGAINST(#{query} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) ORDER BY lexicalScore DESC, rc.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_retrieval_log (user_id, query_text, query_hash, top_k, result_count, latency_ms, metadata, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{queryText}, #{queryHash}, #{topK}, #{resultCount}, #{latencyMs}, #{metadata}, #{createTime})

INSERT INTO rag_answer_citation (retrieval_log_id, chunk_id, rank_no, score, used_in_answer, citation_text, create_time) VALUES (#{retrievalLogId}, #{chunkId}, #{rankNo}, #{score}, b'0', #{citationText}, NOW())
